plotEn:
Pokémon—Zoroark: Master of Illusions is a 2010 Japanese animated adventure fantasy film directed by Kunihiko Yuyama. It is the thirteenth film of the Pokémon anime series and the fourth and final film of Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl.
